cues.en: Here are the big words that are taking the industry by storm machine learning.
cues.zh: 這個席捲產業的熱門名詞，就是機器學習。

cues.en: Now throughout the course, we're going to explore this topic as well as data science and how it all fits into the tech space.
cues.zh: 整門課會探索機器學習與資料科學，以及它們如何融入科技領域。

cues.en: But first things first.
cues.zh: 但先從最重要的開始。

cues.en: You need to be able to explain this topic to your coworkers and not look like you don't know what you're talking about.
cues.zh: 你得向同事解釋這個主題，不能讓人看出你不知道自己在說什麼。

cues.en: So let's start with this.
cues.zh: 先從這裡開始。

cues.en: You see, machines or computers in this case are really, really good at certain things, right?
cues.zh: 機器，這裡指電腦，非常擅長某些事情，對吧？

cues.en: Machines can perform tasks really, really fast.
cues.zh: 機器可以非常快速地執行工作。

cues.en: And we can control these machines and get them to do tasks for us, which is what programming is.
cues.zh: 我們能控制機器，讓它替我們完成任務，這就是程式設計。

cues.en: We program computers, we give them instructions to do tasks, and they do it for us.
cues.zh: 替電腦寫程式，給它指令，它就替我們執行。

cues.en: You see, computers came into this world because it allowed humans to do certain tasks really fast that may have required hundreds of workers before.
cues.zh: 電腦之所以出現，是因為可以讓人快速完成過去可能需要數百位員工的工作。

cues.en: I mean, computers used to actually mean people who do tasks that compute.
cues.zh: 以前 computer 這個字，其實指負責計算的人。

cues.en: They computed things.
cues.zh: 他們執行計算。

cues.en: So for example, let's say I wanted to find out how to get to Daniel's house using Google Maps.
cues.zh: 例如，我想用 Google 地圖找出到 Daniel 家的路。

cues.en: Well, one option is I could pull out a map and with a ruler, measure each of the routes that I could take to Daniel's house.
cues.zh: 可以拿出地圖，用尺量出每條可能的路線。

cues.en: And then do some math, do some addition, and find the shortest path.
cues.zh: 再做數學運算、加總，找出最短路徑。

cues.en: Or I could ask a computer to do this.
cues.zh: 也可以請電腦幫忙。

cues.en: Imagine we had ten different routes instead of me measuring each route one by one.
cues.zh: 假設有 10 條不同路線，不用自己一條條測量。

cues.en: I could simply program and ask a computer.
cues.zh: 只要寫程式，請電腦幫忙。

cues.en: Hey, can you tell me how to get to Daniel's house?
cues.zh: 「可以告訴我怎麼到 Daniel 家嗎？」

cues.en: And through programming, we tell the computer.
cues.zh: 透過程式設計，告訴電腦。

cues.en: Can you calculate really quickly these ten routes and find the shortest one?
cues.zh: 「能不能快速算出這 10 條路線，找到最短的一條？」

cues.en: That's what programming is.
cues.zh: 這就是程式設計。

cues.en: Instead of me taking 10 minutes to figure out how to get to Daniel's house and the fastest route, I just click a button and the computer tells me what to do.
cues.zh: 不用花 10 分鐘自己找最快的路，只要按個按鈕，電腦就會告訴我。

cues.en: Obviously we have to program it and give it instructions, but once we give it a set of instructions, it just like that finds the solution for us.
cues.zh: 當然，必須先寫程式並提供指令，但給它一組指令後，就能立刻找到解答。

cues.en: It computes solutions.
cues.zh: 它會計算解答。

cues.en: And you know why computers became so popular?
cues.zh: 知道電腦為什麼變得這麼普及嗎？

cues.en: Because computers saved companies lots of money instead of hiring lots of workers.
cues.zh: 因為替公司省了很多錢，不用聘請那麼多員工。

cues.en: Well, let's just buy a computer that does the task of 100 workers.
cues.zh: 直接買一台電腦，完成 100 位員工的工作。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: We saved a lot of money and computers don't complain.
cues.zh: 省下很多錢，而且電腦不會抱怨。

cues.en: They'll work 24 seven for you.
cues.zh: 可以全天候替你工作。

cues.en: Now, these machines or computers are really good at things that we can describe, right?
cues.zh: 這些機器，也就是電腦，很擅長處理我們能描述的事情，對吧？

cues.en: That we can write in code if else blocks to do something.
cues.zh: 也就是能用程式碼的 if-else 區塊表達的事。

cues.en: By the way, if you're new to programming, don't worry.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，程式新手不用擔心。

cues.en: We're actually going to start you off from scratch as well with Python.
cues.zh: 我們也會從零教 Python。

cues.en: So don't worry, this part is just theoretical.
cues.zh: 所以別擔心，這部分只是理論。

cues.en: So for example, let's say we talk about roots.
cues.zh: 例如剛才的路線。

cues.en: I can say to the computer, hey, if root one is shorter than root two and if root one is shorter than
cues.zh: 我可以告訴電腦：「如果路線 1 比路線 2 短，而且比，

cues.en: root three, and if root one is shorter than root four and also root five, well, then pick root one as the best option.
cues.zh: 路線 3、路線 4 和路線 5 都短，就選路線 1 作為最佳選擇。」

cues.en: I can describe that through programming to computers, and computers are really good at working on tasks that have these defined rules all the way up to a game of chess.
cues.zh: 可以用程式描述；電腦很擅長處理規則明確的任務，甚至下西洋棋。

cues.en: When you play a game of chess against a computer, we could technically have these if else if then blocks
cues.zh: 與電腦下西洋棋時，理論上可以有許多 if-else、if-then 區塊，

cues.en: lots of them to see how to move each piece and what the pros and cons are.
cues.zh: 判斷每顆棋子怎麼移動，以及各自利弊。

cues.en: And because computers are fast, we can just do a ton of these calculations.
cues.zh: 電腦很快，所以可以做大量這類計算。

cues.en: But then there's a problem.
cues.zh: 但有個問題。

cues.en: What if instead of just trying to get to Daniel's house, we have to ask, is this person angry?
cues.zh: 如果不是找 Daniel 家的路，而是問「這個人是不是在生氣」呢？

cues.en: Let's say somebody left a review on Amazon or we're building a product that detects human emotion.
cues.zh: 例如有人在 Amazon 留評價，或我們開發偵測人類情緒的產品。

cues.en: How can I describe to a computer what angry means?
cues.zh: 要怎麼向電腦描述「生氣」？

cues.en: Can you do that if an if else block?
cues.zh: 可以用 if-else 區塊嗎？

cues.en: What about this?
cues.zh: 那這個呢？

cues.en: What is a cat?
cues.zh: 什麼是貓？

cues.en: How do we tell a computer what a cat is?
cues.zh: 怎麼告訴電腦貓是什麼？

cues.en: Let's say I ask you to program a computer to detect if this picture is a cat or not.
cues.zh: 假設要你寫程式，辨識照片裡是不是貓。

cues.en: Can you program that?
cues.zh: 寫得出來嗎？

cues.en: I mean, sure, you can technically say A yes.
cues.zh: 當然，理論上可以說，

cues.en: This cat has fur, this cat has whiskers, this cat meows.
cues.zh: 「貓有毛、有鬍鬚，會喵喵叫。」

cues.en: But then the computers comes back to you and asks, what is a meow or what are whiskers?
cues.zh: 但電腦會反問，喵喵叫是什麼？鬍鬚又是什麼？

cues.en: What is hair?
cues.zh: 毛是什麼？

cues.en: You see the harder things become to describe, the harder it is for us to tell machines what to do.
cues.zh: 事情越難描述，就越難告訴機器該做什麼。

cues.en: So we hire humans to do these things that are harder for us.
cues.zh: 因此把難以描述的工作交給人類。

cues.en: So we let machines take care of the easier part, which is, you know, things that we can describe and the harder things that are hard to just give instructions to.
cues.zh: 讓機器負責比較容易、能夠明確描述的事情，至於很難直接給指令的工作，

cues.en: Well, we just let humans do it, like being a salesperson or being an artist.
cues.zh: 就交給人類，例如業務或藝術家。

cues.en: Computers aren't good, so we hire humans.
cues.zh: 電腦不擅長，所以聘請人類。

cues.en: But then there's this new idea of machine learning, and you've definitely heard of it because it is a big buzzword right now in our industry because machine learning.
cues.zh: 但後來有了機器學習這個新概念，你一定聽過，現在是產業熱門詞，因為機器學習，

cues.en: Has a lot of applications.
cues.zh: 有很多應用。

cues.en: We could have self-driving cars, robots, vision processing, language processing, recommendation engines, translation services, stock price predictions.
cues.zh: 例如自駕車、機器人、視覺處理、語言處理、推薦引擎、翻譯服務，以及股價預測。

cues.en: There's so many applications, and this is all because of machine learning.
cues.zh: 應用很多，都是因為機器學習。

cues.en: You see things that computers couldn't do before, and only humans can can now be done by computers with machine learning.
cues.zh: 以前電腦做不到、只有人類能做的事，現在可以透過機器學習完成。

cues.en: Well, kind of.
cues.zh: 也不完全是。

cues.en: Sometimes it gets it right.
cues.zh: 有時做對。

cues.en: Sometimes it doesn't.
cues.zh: 有時做錯。

cues.en: And we'll get to that.
cues.zh: 之後會談到。

cues.en: But the idea is this the goal of machine learning is to make machines act more and more like humans
cues.zh: 但概念是，機器學習的目標是讓機器越來越像人類，

cues.en: because the smarter they get, the more they help us humans accomplish our goals.
cues.zh: 因為越聰明，就越能協助人類達成目標。

cues.en: Now, in this section, we're going to go over some theory to get us familiar with this topic, to understand this topic a little bit more.
cues.zh: 這一章會先介紹理論，熟悉並多了解這個主題。

cues.en: But don't get worried, don't get intimidated.
cues.zh: 但別擔心，也別被嚇到。

cues.en: We're going to try and simplify things and have fun along the way.
cues.zh: 我們會盡量簡化，過程也很有趣。

cues.en: And in later sections we're actually going to code build our own machine learning models and do that exciting stuff.
cues.zh: 後續章節會真正寫程式、建立自己的機器學習模型，做那些令人期待的事。

cues.en: But we have to learn the foundations first.
cues.zh: 但要先打好基礎。

cues.en: So let's take a break and I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 先休息一下，下一支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
